title: What can zombies teach us about functional magnetic resonance imaging?
subtitle: With apologies to Dr. Stephen Schlozman
body_html:
Dr. Stephen Schlozman is one of my favorite people. He taught a course about neuroscience as it relates to zombies in order to get neuroscience to be exciting and Harvard.

In his honor, I made the following videos, about the neuroscience of fMRI and why it won’t work for zombies.

Thanks for reading.
